transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I guess some things have been happening at church. People noticed. I'll just be standing by the potluck table, holding the serving spoon up in the air, and... I just stay like that. Or I'll fold the same stack of napkins over and over again, even when people are waiting for me to move.
Do you find yourself doing things like holding an object in place or repeating actions like folding napkins in other places, not just at church?
I don't... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed it at home or anything. Just... well, just there, I guess.
When you're holding the spoon in the air or folding the napkins repeatedly, are you aware that you're doing it, or does it feel like you're not fully in control of those actions?
I don't... I couldn't really say. I'm just... standing there. I don't think much on it until somebody says my name or taps my arm. I just... I don't know.
When you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you realize you're doing it, or does it feel like you're watching yourself from the outside?
No... I don't think it's like that. I ain't outside myself or nothing. I'm just... right there. I just ain't paying much mind to it, I suppose.
While you're doing these things, like holding the spoon or folding the napkins, does it feel like you're on autopilot or like you're not fully aware of what you're doing at the moment?

I reckon it's... well, like I said, I'm just standing by the potluck table. I just... I hold the serving spoon up and don't move, or I'm folding that same stack of napkins over and over. Folks are waiting on me, but... I don't rightly know if it's autopilot. I just do it.
When you're folding the napkins or holding the spoon, can you stop if someone asks you a question or tries to get your attention?
I... I ain't really sure. I guess if they tap my arm or say my name, I stop and put it down. I don't rightly know if I decide to, or what. I just... I stop when they get my attention. That's all.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you feel fully awake and aware, or does it feel like you're in a daze or not completely present?
I don't know... I guess I'm just there. I ain't asleep or nothing. Just standing there.
After you put the spoon down or stop folding the napkins, do you remember doing it, or does it feel like it happened without you knowing?
I remember it, mostly. I just... I know I was doing it. I don't really think about it much after.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others don't seem to understand, or do you believe something is true that other people don't seem to recognize as real?
No. I don't think so. I just... I think regular things, I guess. Nothing nobody else wouldn't understand.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others don't seem to notice, or believed something strongly that others say isn't true?
No... I don't reckon. I just... see what's there, I suppose. I ain't hearing things or nothing like that.
Have you ever had any other times where you felt like you weren't fully aware of what you were doing, even for a short moment, like spacing out or acting automatically, even if nobody noticed?
No, I... I don't think so. I just sit there sometimes, but I ain't spacing out or nothing. Just sitting.
Have you ever had a moment where you suddenly blanked out or weren’t aware of what was happening around you, even for just a few seconds, like your mind went completely blank?
No... I don't go blank like that. I always know where I'm at.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you feel completely aware of your surroundings, or does it feel like your awareness changes in any way, like things seem foggy or distant?
No... I'm just holding it. It ain't foggy or nothing. I know right where I am. I just do my work.

While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, have you ever noticed your body moving in ways you didn't intend, like twitching, jerking, or making other automatic movements without meaning to?
No... I don't twitch or nothing like that. My hands just do what I tell 'em to. I just sit quiet.

Have you ever found yourself doing other things automatically, like fidgeting with your clothes, smacking your lips, or making small movements with your hands or feet, without really noticing you're doing it?
No... I ain't noticed nothing like that. I don't mess with my clothes or nothing. I just stay still.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you ever feel like you can't respond to what's happening around you, like your body isn't reacting the way you want it to?
No... I can move just fine. If somebody calls my name, I look up and answer 'em. I don't get stuck or nothing like that. I'm just minding my own business.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you ever feel like your thoughts are not your own or that something outside of you is controlling what you do?
No... it's just me. I'm just sitting there. Nobody's controlling me or putting thoughts in my head. I just think my own thoughts.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you ever feel like you're in a dream or that the world around you isn't quite real?
No... I don't think so. Things seem real enough to me. I just sit there. I ain't in no dream.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, does it ever feel like you're not completely connected to yourself or like you're somehow separate from your body, even just a little bit?
No... I don't feel like that. I'm just... I'm just me, sitting there. I'm in my body same as always.
While you're holding the spoon or folding the napkins, do you ever feel like your awareness is different than usual, like you're not as alert or you're in a haze, even just a little bit?
No... I don't think so. I'm just awake, like normal. Just sitting there. It's not hazy or nothing.
